def span(self, frame, count=1, bounds="[)", exact=False, week_start=1):
    if not 1 <= week_start <= 7:
        raise ValueError("week_start argument must be between 1 and 7.")
    util.validate_bounds(bounds)
    fa, fr, rs = self._get_frames(frame)
    a = "day" if fa == "week" else "month" if fa == "quarter" else fa
    fl = self
    if not exact:
        i = self._ATTRS.index(a)
        frames = self._ATTRS[:i+1]
        vals = [getattr(self, f) for f in frames] + [1]*max(0, 3-len(frames))
        fl = self.__class__(*vals, tzinfo=self.tzinfo)
        if fa == "week":
            d = 7 if week_start > self.isoweekday() else 0
            fl = fl.shift(days=-(self.isoweekday() - week_start) - d)
        elif fa == "quarter":
            fl = fl.shift(months=-((self.month - 1) % 3))
    cl = fl.shift(**{fr: count * rs})
    if bounds[0] == "(":
        fl = fl.shift(microseconds=+1)
    if bounds[1] == ")":
        cl = cl.shift(microseconds=-1)
    return fl, cl
